fpl_core_insights.resolution_policy: moving main resolved to immutable latest verified commit

decision_policy.primary_selection: maximum exact-mechanics expected points among the sealed near-optimal legal squad frontier
decision_policy.elite_convergence_rule: >=13/15 overlap with max-EV and same captain at 0.25%, 0.50%, 1.00%
decision_policy.elite_failure_fallback: not applicable; Elite has no publication authority
decision_policy.uncertainty: correlated scenarios/CVaR/regret are diagnostics, not a second hidden forecast
decision_policy.deadline_mechanics: exact XI/captain/vice/autosub mechanics in every horizon Gameweek
decision_policy.same_surface_check: sealed decision bundle identity and all material input hashes must match
decision_policy.next_projection_upgrade: empirical-Bayes shrinkage of small-sample player rates toward role/position priors
decision_policy.future_transfer_rules: rolled free transfers, current cash/selling prices and explicit -4 hit costs; future moves remain contingent and are re-solved before every deadline
decision_policy.future_price_assumption: current official prices held fixed; no speculative price-rise forecast

recommendation.selector_reason: The sealed near-optimal squad frontier is rescored across every Gameweek with exact XI, captain, vice-captain and autosub mechanics; that single Decision object is the production authority.

epsilon_convergence.rule: >=13/15 overlap with max-EV and same captain at 0.25%, 0.50%, 1.00%

warnings: exact-mechanics shortlist hit its configured candidate limit before exhausting the disclosed near-optimal band
published captain is chosen in only 37% of uncertainty re-solves where he remains in the XI; the provisional diagnostic reference is 50%
covariance coefficients are transparent priors until enough 2026/27 deadline outcomes exist

joint_initial_path.note: Joint-path scoring uses exact GW1 mechanics and the existing legal transfer MILP from GW2 onward. Future moves are planning contingencies and must be re-solved before each deadline.
